brief: Microsoft and Meta report earnings as AI spending surges; COVID origin debate rekindled; Salman Rushdie attacker convicted. Research explores colormap design, visualization annotation, and LLM-based science simplification.
news_summary: Microsoft's profit jumps 31% on increased AI spending; Meta's profit falls 14% amid heavy AI investment. Trump threatens Iran, and Republicans threaten to block Blanche nomination. Rushdie attacker convicted of aiding Hezbollah.
papers_summary: Papers present interactive colormap extraction, a benchmark for visualization annotation, and LLM-based simplification of scientific summaries. Additional works explore XAI for stroke rehab and chart refinement preserving data integrity.
